literature_notes: All five ledger lines describe tags on intracellular faces of SGMS2. L1/L2/L3 use pEGFP-C3, which fuses GFP to the protein N-terminus; SGMS2's N-terminus (residues 1–75) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so these are cytoplasmic tags. L5 places a V5 tag C-terminally (hSMS2-V5-P2A-mCherry), and the C-terminus (residues 292–365) is also intracellular. L4 reports a V5-tagged SMS2 construct with no stated insertion position; both termini are intracellular and no extracellular loop residue is named, so no junction can be pinned. SGMS2 has three extracellular loops (ECL1: 101–125, ECL2: 180–222, ECL3: 270–274), but none of the ledger lines reports a tag insertion in any of them. Zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: pEGFP-C3 N-terminal GFP fusion places the tag before residue 1, which lies in the intracellular N-terminal domain (residues 1–75); tag is cytoplasmic, not extracellular.
hSMS2-V5-P2A-mCherry places V5 after the last residue (T365); the C-terminus (residues 292–365) is intracellular, so the tag faces the cytoplasm.
